about.title: The author behind Seogard
about.role: Vue.js Lead Dev · founder of Seogard
about.intro: I build Vue.js interfaces and Seogard to help teams find SEO issues, understand what changed and know what to fix.
about.why1: A deployment can leave a page looking perfect while breaking its titles, tags or server-rendered content. These issues can easily slip past a visual check.
about.why2: I created Seogard to make those changes visible: HTML/JavaScript comparison, regression monitoring and reports you can act on. Fewer manual checks, more focused fixes.
about.rules: The guides connect each issue to an explanation, a way to verify it and suggested fixes. Work through them with your technical team or AI assistant.
about.ctaTitle: Find what needs fixing on your site
about.ctaText: Enter your URL and create your account to run your first scan with a free 14-day Cloud trial. No credit card required.
about.seoDescription: Aadil Talbi, Vue.js Lead Dev and founder of Seogard. Technical SEO monitoring through raw HTML and JavaScript rendering comparisons.
